mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cw_memory_consent (subject_type, subject_id, agent_id, scope_id, status, consent_version, granted_at_ms, withdrawn_at_ms, updated_at_ms) VALUES (#{record.subjectType}, #{record.subjectId}, #{record.agentId}, #{record.scopeId}, #{record.status}, #{record.consentVersion}, #{record.grantedAtMs}, #{record.withdrawnAtMs}, #{record.updatedAtMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE scope_id = VALUES(scope_id), status = VALUES(status), consent_version = VALUES(consent_version), granted_at_ms = VALUES(granted_at_ms), withdrawn_at_ms = VALUES(withdrawn_at_ms), updated_at_ms = VALUES(updated_at_ms)
